The Forest, The Wastes, And The Oasis.name: The Forest, The Wastes, And The Oasis

shader_resolution.note: Unity strips Shader asset names in this build; materials keep the shader PathID (shader_<pid>) plus their serialized _Color/_FromHue/_VminAtS0/_VmaxAtS0/... properties. A runtime plugin dump can resolve the real shader names if needed.

procedural.note: raw CSV is preserved byte-for-byte under parts/*.txt (values use a comma decimal in the shipped build); the parsed maps convert ',' to '.' for convenience. parts[name] = sheet grid (rows x columns) for the corresponding sheet in sheets/<name>.png.

prefabs.note: readable Transform/SpriteRenderer hierarchy for the in-world prefab roots; MonoBehaviour-only components need a runtime plugin dump (see assets/game/README.md)

reference.capture_method: BibitesBridge GET /screenshot (main camera -> offscreen RenderTexture); game window hidden via BibitesAPI lab harness
